text:
raj: Heads-up: Kestrel Analytics (enterprise) says the contract promo we agreed in Q4 didn't apply to invoice 45321. Sales added PO note but billing system never picked it up. Can someone triage?

emma: Sorry — can you paste the PO note exactly as it was submitted and the promo amount?

raj: PO note from contract: `Promo: KESTREL-Q4-2025 ApplyCredit $25000 PO# 998877`

raj: Promo amount $25,000. Customer says they attached PO 998877 when submitting.

liam: Looking at our PO parsing rules — we usually match `ApplyPromo:` or `PromoCode:` keys. The PO note here starts with `Promo:` then freeform text, so it likely missed the mapping.

nate: Can you confirm invoice id and any ledger ref? I'll look up whether a credit memo exists.

raj: Invoice 45321, ledger ref I-45321-KESTREL. No credit shows on customer portal. Customer called support and gave screenshot.

emma: Please run the ledger query and paste results. Quick command we use: ```
# ledger lookup
rdw ledger query --invoice 45321 --format json
```

nate: Running now... no promo credit lines returned for I-45321-KESTREL. Only charges. So system never created a credit entry.

olivia: From finance side, we'll need a manual credit memo + journal entry referencing the contract and PO note. Can you confirm GL code to use? For promo credits we use GL 7002 (customer credits — promotions). Also need sales approval on file.

raj: Sales has sign-off in the contract PDF. I can attach it here: https://redwood.s3.amazonaws.com/contracts/kestrel_q4_signed.pdf

jordi: I'll ping the customer and let them know we're on it and that we'll issue a credit within 48 hours once finance confirms. I'll ask for any additional PO attachment if needed. :thumbsup:

liam: To avoid recurrence, I'll add a patch to PO parsing rules to treat `Promo:` as an alias for `ApplyPromo:`. Quick regex suggestion we can add: ```
/(?:ApplyPromo:|Promo:|PromoCode:?)\s*(\S+)/i
```

deploy-bot: Deployment queued: eng-platform/po-parser#fix-promo-alias -> staging (PR 1128)

nate: Finance, if you confirm I'll create credit memo CM-45321-K and post to invoice. Proposed credit amount: $25,000. Please confirm GL 7002 and approval chain.

olivia: Confirmed GL 7002. I need a one-line internal memo: "Manual promo credit per Sales PO 998877 (Kestrel)" + link to signed contract + sales approver name. 

raj: Approver is Raj Patel (raj). Contract link above.

nate: Creating credit memo now and will attach contract PDF and sales approver note. I'll also open an accounting ticket for audit trace. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-3092

nate: Done — credit memo CM-45321-K created for $25,000, awaiting posting after Olivia's sign-off.

olivia: Posted. Journal entry JNL-77821 created. Credit applied to invoice 45321. Customer balance updated.

jordi: Thanks — I'll message the customer and confirm they see the credit.

emma: Can we add a monitoring alert to catch PO notes that reference promo-ish keywords but don't create a credit? Maybe a daily job that flags unmatched PO notes containing `Promo`/`Apply`/`Credit`.

liam: Good idea. I'll add an alert to INF-7842: "PO parser: unmatched promo keywords" and include a small repro dataset. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-7842

raj: Thanks everyone. Customer notified and happy. Closing on our side once INF-7842 PR is merged and FIN-3092 is archived. :tada:
